description: Header file defining UserSettingsDelegate class, including nested notification handler classes, for managing user settings and text track styles, with functions for getting/setting preferences and handling notifications.

classes.name: UserSettingsDelegate
classes.description: Manages user settings and text track styles, handles notifications, and interfaces with external user settings and text track components.

classes.name: UserSettingsNotificationHandler
classes.description: Handles notifications related to user settings changes, such as language, captions, and accessibility features.

classes.name: TextTrackNotificationHandler
classes.description: Handles notifications related to text track style changes, such as caption styles.

methods.name: HandleSubscription
methods.description: Registers or unregisters notification handlers for user settings and text track events based on subscription requests.

methods.name: HandleEvent
methods.description: Processes incoming events and determines if they are relevant to user settings, managing registration accordingly.

methods.name: GetUserSettingsInterface
methods.description: Retrieves the IUserSettings interface, querying via the shell if necessary.

methods.name: GetTextTrackInterface
methods.description: Retrieves the ITextTrackClosedCaptionsStyle interface, querying via the shell if necessary.

methods.name: GetVoiceGuidance
methods.description: Fetches the voice guidance setting from user settings.

methods.name: GetAudioDescription
methods.description: Fetches the audio description setting.

methods.name: GetAudioDescriptionsEnabled
methods.description: Fetches whether audio descriptions are enabled.

methods.name: GetHighContrast
methods.description: Retrieves the high contrast setting.

methods.name: GetCaptions
methods.description: Retrieves the captions enabled state.

methods.name: GetClosedCaptionsStyle
methods.description: Retrieves current closed captions style settings.

methods.name: SetVoiceGuidance
methods.description: Sets the voice guidance enabled state.

methods.name: SetAudioDescriptionsEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables audio descriptions.

methods.name: SetCaptions
methods.description: Enables or disables captions.

methods.name: SetVoiceGuidanceRate
methods.description: Sets the rate for voice guidance.

methods.name: SetVoiceGuidanceHints
methods.description: Enables or disables voice guidance hints.

methods.name: GetVoiceGuidanceRate
methods.description: Retrieves the voice guidance rate.

methods.name: GetVoiceGuidanceHints
methods.description: Retrieves the voice guidance hints setting.

methods.name: GetPresentationLanguage
methods.description: Gets the current presentation language, returning the language code before the dash.

methods.name: GetLocale
methods.description: Retrieves the current locale setting.

methods.name: SetLocale
methods.description: Sets the locale/presentation language.

methods.name: GetPreferredAudioLanguages
methods.description: Gets preferred audio languages as a JSON array string.

methods.name: GetPreferredCaptionsLanguages
methods.description: Gets preferred captions languages as a JSON array string.

methods.name: SetPreferredAudioLanguages
methods.description: Sets preferred audio languages, accepting JSON array or string.

methods.name: SetPreferredCaptionsLanguages
methods.description: Sets preferred captions languages, accepting JSON array or string.
